name: Adaptive Stream Line Seeding
definition: An algorithm to seed stream lines adaptively by subdividing lines in areas where flow diverges (turbulent/vortices) and leaving laminar areas sparse. It uses two CUDA kernels (control and evaluation) alternately invoked by the CPU.
summary: Adaptive Stream Line Seeding dynamically refines vector field visualization by iteratively subdividing neighboring stream lines when their distance exceeds a threshold, concentrating density in complex flow regions.
